harmony.editorial_transformation: The public-domain two-staff MIDI was separated into soprano, alto, tenor, and bass by sustained-note continuity and minimum-motion voice leading. Its final release gate was restored to the written cadence. Every part is transposed up 1 semitone.

source.label: BISHOPGARTH
source.attribution: Arthur Sullivan, 1897; catalogued for the iambic 8.7.8.7 form.
source.editorial_transformation: The final NoteWorthy MIDI release gate was extended to the written cadence and timing was normalized from 192 to 480 PPQ. Every part is transposed up 1 semitone.
